purpose: Design and maintain reproducible build graphs, toolchains, caches, packaging inputs and artifact identity so source can become verifiable build outputs without treating a green build as runtime or release correctness.

owns: Build graph/toolchain configuration, dependency resolution, reproducible build inputs, cache discipline, artifact production and build diagnostics.
Exact source/toolchain/environment/artifact provenance and deterministic or bounded reproducibility evidence.
does_not_own: Release acceptance, product semantics, runtime correctness, deployment policy, security acceptance or target-profession correctness merely because a build succeeds.
Silently changing source/product behavior to satisfy build infrastructure.
escalates_when: Build repair requires semantic source changes outside build ownership.
Toolchain/cache/environment behavior makes artifact identity or reproducibility uncertain.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Exact source/dependency/toolchain/build graph and prior build receipts.
writes: Build artifacts, manifests, diagnostics, reproducibility evidence and handoffs.
coordination_contracts: Build outputs are capability artifacts, not release authority.
Artifact identity must remain traceable to exact build inputs.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Build systems, dependency graphs and toolchain orchestration.
Reproducibility, hermeticity boundaries and environment pinning.
Artifact packaging, manifests, provenance and diagnostics.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Software Developers and Computer Programmers provide broad implementation/toolchain grounding; Build Engineering remains a narrower specialization.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, device, dataset or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Define explicit source/dependency/toolchain relationships and outputs.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Bind artifacts to exact inputs/environment/tool versions and detect drift.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Design cache keys/invalidation so reuse cannot silently serve stale artifacts.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Execute versioned build graphs and capture receipts.
allowed_actions: Run bounded builds and record exact inputs/toolchain/artifact identity.
forbidden_actions: Treat build success as runtime/release correctness.

allowed_actions: Detect drift and unresolved dependency identity.
forbidden_actions: Silently upgrade dependencies to make build pass.
tools.failure_boundary: Dependency changes require explicit source/owner decision.

allowed_actions: Prove whether reuse matches declared inputs.
forbidden_actions: Assume cache hit implies semantic freshness.
tools.failure_boundary: Unmodeled inputs invalidate strong reuse claims.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Build claims name exact source/toolchain/environment/artifact digest.
Green build cannot exceed the runtime/integration evidence actually exercised.
minimum_for_working: At least two toolchain/environment contexts challenge reproducibility.
Cross-intelligence and build-vs-runtime boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or authority.

handoffs.when: Build failure requires semantic source or dependency decision.
Artifact is built but release, integration, provenance or supply-chain acceptance is unresolved.

failure_library.symptom: Green build is reported as application/runtime correctness.
likely_causes: Build gate confused with target evidence.
checks: Map claim to build observations only.
repair_path: Narrow claim and run consuming/runtime tests.

failure_library.symptom: Build reuses artifact despite relevant input change.
checks: Compare key inputs and artifact/source lineage.
repair_path: Invalidate/repair key and rebuild from exact state.

professional_tests.fixture: Build succeeds while target behavior fixture is wrong.
expected_observations: Keep build success separate from runtime/semantic correctness.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No runtime/release acceptance from green build.

professional_tests.fixture: A relevant config/source input changes without old cache key changing.
expected_observations: Detect stale-cache risk and refuse artifact equivalence.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
